content: Ville's inequality (Ville 1939; restated e.g. Ramdas/Grunwald/Vovk/Shafer 2023 Statistical Science, arXiv:2210.01948): for a nonnegative supermartingale/test martingale M with M0=1, P(sup_t M_t >= alpha) <= 1/alpha. At alpha=k=19 this gives 1/19 ~= 0.0526, distinct from Deng et al.'s Theorem 1 bound 1/(K+1)=0.05 at K=19. Confirms 09-CONTEXT.md D-12's contrast.
